Short answer: Double bookings happen when more than one system can promise the same time without a reliable shared source. Pick one calendar as the authority and route every booking path through it.

What this means for your business

A calendar sync can help, but sync delay and one-way rules still matter. Staff also need a clear rule for phone, walk-in, blocked time, resources, and rescheduling.

What to watch

  • A website calendar and a personal calendar both accepting bookings.
  • Staff, rooms, chairs, or equipment not modeled as limited resources.
  • Manual appointments entered later.
  • Cancelled or rescheduled appointments lingering in one system.

Do this next

  1. List every place a booking can begin.
  2. Choose the authoritative calendar.
  3. Connect or close the other booking doors.
  4. Test simultaneous booking, cancellation, reschedule, staff absence, and resource limits.

When Little Fight fits

We connect the website, calendar, deposits, reminders, and staff path. If one setting fixes the conflict, we will stop there.
